# Code of Conduct

## Our standards

Contributors are expected to be respectful, constructive, and considerate.
Harassment, discrimination, personal attacks, intimidation, and publishing
private information without consent are not acceptable.

## Scope and enforcement

This policy applies in project spaces and when someone represents the project.
Report conduct concerns privately to the repository maintainers through
<https://github.com/apimgr>. Maintainers will review reports and take
appropriate action to keep project spaces respectful and constructive.
